text:
Hiram L. Dorman School enrollment drops to 257 students in 2025-26
In the 2025-26 school year, Hiram L. Dorman School reported enrolling 257 students, according to data from the Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education.
This figure represents a 7.9% decrease compared with the prior year, when there were 279 students enrolled.
For the 2025-26 school year, girls made up 52.5% of the student body, while boys accounted for 47.5%.
Hispanic students comprised the majority of enrollment at Hiram L. Dorman School, making up 69.3% of the total student population.
The school is part of Springfield Public Schools District, which has its central office in Springfield.
Across Massachusetts, there were 900,487 students enrolled during the 2025-26 school year.
Massachusetts ranks sixth in the nation in per-pupil spending, with the state allocating nearly $25,000 for each student, according to a 2026 Education Data Initiative report.
A 2026 analysis from WalletHub ranked Massachusetts first among all states for its education system, evaluating criteria such as student achievement, class size, funding, school safety, and teacher qualifications.
